name: questionnaire_parsing
description: Takes JSON data extracted by the LLM from the user, validates it against Pydantic models, and updates the global BUA_data_structure.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: The section of the BUA form being saved (e.g., 'project_registration', 'project_and_pi', 'additional_contacts', 'personnel', 'room_usage', 'biological_agents', 'project_summary').

inputs.name: raw_data
inputs.description: A JSON-formatted string matching the fields required by the target stage. 'project_registration' requires only university, state, bua_number, project_title (no PI). 'project_and_pi' requires pi_info or equivalent PI fields.

outputs.description: Returns the validation status, next stage to fetch, and the current global state of the BUA form.

output.message: Data successfully validated and saved for project_registration.
Data successfully validated and saved for project_and_pi.
